concept: a thinking partner with no upstream
ratified: 2026-08-03 — founder-approved editorial-ambition package; concept pre-existed in the corpus
canonicalExplanation: What a rep actually wants is somewhere to process a deal honestly — the way they already do in the parking lot — except with something that talks back and remembers. The defining property is architectural: no manager view, no admin seat, nothing that surfaces to anyone upstream.
avoidWhen: team-tooling contexts where shared visibility is the legitimate goal
